iberia.title: Península Ibérica
iberia.description: España, Portugal e Andorra — Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Lisboa, Porto; os Pireneos, a Meseta, o Algarve e as Baleares.

south-central-us.title: Centro-sur dos Estados Unidos
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Luisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi e Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, Nova Orleáns, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson e Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa e Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa Americana, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau e Wallis e Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi e Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila e as illas de Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam e as Illas Marianas do Norte
mariana-islands.description: Guam e as Illas Marianas do Norte — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian e Rota.

greenland.title: Groenlandia
greenland.description: Groenlandia — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq e Tasiilaq; o manto de xeo, o fiorde de xeo de Ilulissat e os fiordes do sur.

bermuda.title: Bermudas
bermuda.description: Bermudas — Hamilton, St. George’s e o Arsenal da Mariña Real, as parroquias da illa e as súas praias de area rosa.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gómel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno e Brest; o bosque de Białowieża e as brañas de Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Illas da Canle
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark e Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port e Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Illas Feroe
faroe-islands.description: As Illas Feroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík e as dezaoito illas, coas súas aldeas, túneles e cantís.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard e Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg e Ny-Ålesund; os glaciares e fiordes de Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo e Comino — A Valeta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria e as Tres Cidades.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar e as illas do océano Índico
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, as Comores, Mayotte, A Reunión, Mauricio e as Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis e Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudán
sudan.description: Sudán — Khartum, Omdurmán, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid e Nyala; a confluencia do Nilo Azul e o Nilo Branco e as pirámides de Meroe.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria e as dez illas, de Santo Antão a Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé e Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé e Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António e as selvas e praias das dúas illas.

saint-helena.title: Santa Helena, Ascensión e Tristán da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Santa Helena, a illa de Ascensión e Tristán da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown e Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet e Cox’s Bazar; os Sundarbans e o delta do Ganxes e o Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka e as Maldivas
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka e as Maldivas — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura e Malé; as terras altas, Sigiriya e os atois.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Cidade Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An e Can Tho; a baía de Ha Long e o delta do Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipinas
philippines.description: Filipinas — Manila, Quezon City, Cebú, Davao, Iloílo, Baguio e Zamboanga; Luzón, as Visayas, Mindanao e Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia e Timor Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia e Timor Leste — Iacarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar e Dili; Xava, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Célebes e Papúa.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaisia, Singapur e Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaisia, Singapur e Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malaca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching e Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine e o lago Inle; o val do Irrawaddy e os outeiros Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Camboxa e Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Camboxa e Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap e Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang e Pakse; o Mekong e o Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartaxena e Bucaramanga; os Andes, a costa do Caribe e a Amazonia.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida e Ciudad Bolívar; o Salto Ángel, o Orinoco e a illa Margarita.

peru.title: Perú
peru.description: Perú — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos e Puno; Machu Picchu, o lago Titicaca e o Val Sagrado.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta e Baños; a Avenida dos Volcáns, a Amazonia e as illas Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — A Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre e Potosí; o lago Titicaca e o Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena e Punta Arenas; Atacama, a Rexión dos Lagos, a Patagonia e a illa de Pascua.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguai e Uruguai
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguai e Uruguai — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este e Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: As Güianas
guianas.description: Güiana, Suriname e a Güiana Francesa — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Caiena e Kourou; as fervenzas Kaieteur e a selva do escudo güianés.

falklands.title: Illas Malvinas
falklands.description: As Illas Malvinas (Falkland) — Stanley, Goose Green e as illas de Soledad e Gran Malvina.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sidney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaida, Hobart, Darwin e Canberra; a Gran Barreira de Coral, Uluru e o Outback.

new-zealand.title: Nova Zelandia
new-zealand.description: Nova Zelandia — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin e Queenstown; os Alpes do Sur, Fiordland e Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: Columbia Británica
british-columbia.description: Columbia Británica — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George e Whistler; a Cordilleira Costeira, a illa de Vancouver e o Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Pradarías canadenses
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan e Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina e Banff; as Rochosas, as pradarías e Churchill na baía de Hudson.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston e Thunder Bay; as fervenzas do Niágara, os Grandes Lagos e o parque Algonquin.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montreal, a cidade de Quebec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke e Saguenay; o San Lourenzo, os Laurentides e a península de Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Canadá atlántico
atlantic-canada.description: Novo Brunswick, Nova Escocia, a Illa do Príncipe Eduardo e Terranova e Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton e Charlottetown; o Cabot Trail e a baía de Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Norte do Canadá
northern-canada.description: Yukon, os Territorios do Noroeste e Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City e Inuvik; o arquipélago Ártico e o río Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong e Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong e Macau — a illa de Hong Kong, Kowloon, os Novos Territorios, Lantau e a península de Macau, Taipa e Coloane.
